scripts.dev: env -u EXPO_TOKEN sh -c 'if [ -n "$REPLIT_EXPO_SESSION_SECRET" ]; then pnpm exec create-launch login --session "$REPLIT_EXPO_SESSION_SECRET" || true; fi' && env -u EXPO_TOKEN EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL=https://$REPLIT_EXPO_DEV_DOMAIN EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=${EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL:-https://$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN/api} EXPO_PUBLIC_DOMAIN=$REPLIT_DEV_DOMAIN EXPO_PUBLIC_REPL_ID=$REPL_ID REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=$REPLIT_EXPO_DEV_DOMAIN pnpm exec expo start --localhost --port $PORT --clear
